---
title: "Page Log"
---

This page will show how far I've read in each book and how many pages I've read on each date.

## Daily reading

We'll create a `reading_log.csv` dataset with one row per book per logged date, recording the page reached.

Using `dplyr`, we'll calculate pages read between updates. For accurate daily totals, we'll distinguish starting page positions from pages actually read that day.
